↓
1362284571937566720 [2021-02-18] @visakanv 💜 292 🔁 40
sometimes simple truths have to be restated in fresh language to brush off the thick dust of familiarity and reveal the godly sheen underneath
↓
1362285711055986692 [2021-02-18] @visakanv 💜 130 🔁 6
but if you assert “we’ve got it, we’ve got the perfect conceptualization of the absolute truth”, you will attract True Believers who chant it mindlessly, and quickly the heavy fog of familiarity descends upon everyone and you have to abscond into the wilderness to see again
↓

it’s all tracings in the sand

we are all tracings in the sand

The right column is titled "Intuition Now" and includes a smaller image of a dog, along with a lengthy passage of text that describes overthinking and analyzing one's intuition. 
    
    The passage on the right reads: "i don't feel good about this situation, but maybe it's just indigestion, or some cognitive bias. I should make a journal entry about everything i see and hear in this enviornment, and isolate each one in a Focusing exercise to determine if my subconscious is picking up on something I should recognize consciously, or if it's just a physiological artifact—then cross-reference with known emotional triggers and—did that guy just stab me? I'm..." The text is presented in a typewriter-style font, adding to the meme's nostalgic and humorous tone.
